chosen.rule: minimise FP + FN over archetypes (equal weight, both A curves); tie-break: smaller resample fraction, larger d_below, lower accept

narrow_noisy.expectation: raw max-min passes often by noise; new method rejects or resamples

one_sided.expectation: wide but not spectrum support: no rung above A

outlier.expectation: not discarded: the rest of the ladder is strong

ceiling.expectation: recognised as fragile: extremes sit at the band edges

too_easy_reserve.expectation: the reserve extension recovers the hard side; the round-0 ladder alone cannot
